summary: Circumstantial evidence standard: must, not may, point to guilt; confessional statement and recovery of body/clothes under S.27 Evidence Act; discrepancies in witness accounts (location of confession); post-mortem inconclusive due to decomposition; courts below upheld conviction under IPC s.302, s.376(2)(g), s.201; death sentence confirmed; appeal challenges evidentiary sufficiency and consistency of chain.
legal_provisions_cited: Indian Penal Code s.302, s.376(2)(g), s.201
Pritinder Singh alias Lovely v. State of Punjab
